### GetOffset(string)

Gets the offset east of UTC for a named zone at the current transaction's start instant.

```csharp
public static TimeSpan GetOffset(string zone)
```

Parameters:

`zone` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

A PostgreSQL timezone name, abbreviation, or POSIX timezone specification.

Returns: [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)

The offset, including historical seconds where applicable.

Requires the active backend thread. Fixed abbreviations retain their fixed offsets;
dynamic abbreviations and full zone names resolve at transaction start.

<a id="member-a819d27eb8227659"></a>

### GetOffset(string, PgTimestampTz)

Gets the offset east of UTC for a named zone at a particular finite instant.

```csharp
public static TimeSpan GetOffset(string zone, PgTimestampTz instant)
```

Parameters:

`zone` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

A PostgreSQL timezone name, abbreviation, or POSIX timezone specification.

`instant` — [PgTimestampTz](/api/ankus.pgtimestamptz/)

The instant at which to resolve historical and daylight-saving rules.

Returns: [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)

The offset, including historical seconds where applicable.

Exceptions:

- [ArgumentOutOfRangeException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentoutofrangeexception): The instant is infinite.

Requires the active backend thread and leaves the session timezone unchanged.
PostgreSQL's native timezone routines determine behavior across its complete timestamp range.
